transcript:
This is NPR News Now.
The latest headlines every hour.
>> Live from NPR News, I'm Giles Snyder.
President Trump is back in Washington, D.C.,
arriving overnight after taking the stage in San Antonio
as part of his push in support of Republican candidates
in November's midterm elections.
Trump repeated comments he made at a rally in Nebraska,
suggesting that Iran could attack Los Angeles or San Diego,
and he returned to that $5,000 promise
if Republicans retain control of the House and Senate.
But rallygoers like David Wessels say a check is not why he turned out.
>> I'm not sure if we'll get the $5,000 or not that he promised,
but that's not what I'm here for.
I'm here to thank my president.
>> The president's trip to Texas was his third in less than a month.
He appeared on stage with Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton,
who was locked in a tight race with Democrat James Talarico.
His remarks were interrupted by protesters multiple times.
The Trump administration began sending $500 checks
to some people with Obamacare plans.
Ethics experts say the checks may violate laws
that prohibit government officials from using their office
to influence elections, as NPR's Selena Simmons-Duffin reports.
>> I spoke to Ellen Allen minutes after the check arrived
at her house near Charleston, West Virginia.
>> I just can't believe it.
I mean, that's crazy.
>> Ellen runs a small nonprofit called West Virginians
for Affordable Healthcare.
She has mixed feelings about the money
and the letter that came with it from the Trump administration.
>> I think it's more of a political stunt.
If they cared really about the cost of healthcare,
they would do something that would make healthcare affordable
for every American.
>> She says she plans to deposit the check in her health savings account
and keep working for healthcare for all.
Selena Simmons-Duffin, NPR News, Washington.
>> Secretary of State Marco Rubio telling Europeans to,
in his words, "Wake up from their slumber
and save Western civilization."
His speech in Athens filled with Christian nationalist rhetoric,
as NPR's Michelle Kellerman reports.
>> With the acropolis as a backdrop,
Secretary Rubio says the world has much to learn
from the men of ancient Greece,
who knew there was nothing selfish about fighting for their own interests.
But he says nationalism has become a dirty word,
and now the West is at a crossroads.
>> The course we take will determine
whether the West maintains its place at the head of the world
or resigns itself to a future of atrophy and servitude and decline.
>> Rubio says the Trump administration plans to dominate
the fields of drone warfare, critical minerals,
and artificial intelligence,
which Trump is trying to rebrand as superintelligence
to play down calls for regulations.
Michelle Kellerman, NPR News, the State Department.
>> And you're listening to NPR News.
>> Easty East is now the first hurricane of the Atlantic season.
In its latest advisory,
the National Hurricane Center in Miami said Easty East
has strengthened into a Category 1 storm,
with top-sustained winds of 75 miles per hour.
That storm on a track toward the Gulf Coast for later this week.
The storm expected to bring heavy rain
and the potential for flash flooding.
OpenAI has released what it says are solutions
to hundreds of complex math problems.
And Pierre-Chef Bromfield reports that mathematicians
are struggling to check the company's work.
>> In an online repository,
OpenAI published what it said were 377 solutions
to outstanding math problems in fields
ranging from number theory to topology.
The results come just a month
after the company published what it claimed was a solution
to one of the toughest problems in mathematics.
Mathematicians are still checking that finding,
and they criticized OpenAI for failing to effectively show
how its machine found an answer.
This time, the company did include its AI's reasoning,
but only for 10 of the problems so far.
Jeff Bromfield, NPR News.
>> Los Angeles Dodgers are returning
to the National League Championship Series,
advancing with a 4-1 win over the Atlanta Braves
in Game 4 of their Best of 5 Division Series.
They'll play for the pennant
against the winner of the other division series
between the Milwaukee Brewers
and the San Diego Padres.
The Dodgers are seeking to become
the first national league team
to win three straight World Series titles.
I'm Jael Snyder.
This is NPR News.
>> This message comes from total wine and more.
Football season is here.
Stop by for cold beer, craft bourbon,
and ready-to-drink cocktails,
and know you're getting the lowest prices.
Spirits are not sold in Virginia and North Carolina.
drink responsibly, be 21.

topics.text: President Trump campaigns in San Antonio for Republican midterm candidates, repeats Iran attack claims
Trump administration sends $500 checks to Obamacare recipients; ethics experts cite potential election law violations
Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivers Christian nationalist speech in Athens about Western civilization
Trump administration plans to dominate drone warfare, critical minerals, and artificial intelligence fields
Hurricane Easty East strengthens to Category 1 storm, threatens Gulf Coast with heavy rain
OpenAI releases solutions to 377 complex math problems; mathematicians struggle to verify findings
Los Angeles Dodgers defeat Atlanta Braves 4-1, advance to National League Championship Series
